title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (IC3)
description:
About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to help us scale our Platform Product, ship new API endpoints and Cal Atoms, and collaborate closely with our platform customers. This role is async by default, remote, and part of a company culture that prioritizes deep work, flexibility, and real ownership. For this role we are looking for people working in the US Timezone → US, Latin America and/or South America are ideal locations.

You’ll work closely with our product and engineering teams and be trusted to take initiative, experiment, and ship high-impact software.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain complex timezone logic, availability blocking, and calendar APIs
  • Oversee the evolution of our Platform Product
  • Create and ship Cal Atoms (frontend components)
  • Develop new API endpoints for embedded use cases
  • Collaborate with platform customers and internal teams to solve complex problems

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience building and maintaining APIs for long-term success
  • Full-stack engineering skills, comfortable working across frontend and backend (TypeScript, React, NestJS, tRPC, Tailwind and Prisma)
  • Ability to quickly understand and work on complex technical challenges
  • High autonomy mindset — works well independently and collaboratively in a remote, async-first setup
  • Strong written communication (clarity > formality)

Bonus Skills

  • Previous startup or remote-first experience
  • Familiarity with open-source contribution and our GitHub project
  • Experience in building platform products or developer-facing APIs

How We Hire: The Lean Hire Trial

We approach hiring differently. Nearly all full-time roles at Cal.com begin with a 30-day contract-to-hire trial, which we call a Lean Hire. This isn’t a test to prove yourself; it’s a mutual exploration. Think of it more like dating than interviewing.

  • It gives you time to experience the culture, team, and work before committing
  • It gives us a chance to ensure alignment without long-term risk on either side
  • Many of our strongest team members joined through Lean Hire and never looked back

Success in a Lean Hire isn’t about perfection; it’s about curiosity, transparency, and seeing whether we thrive working together.

Why Work at Cal.com

We’re building Cal.com not just as a product, but as a place to do great work and live a good life.

  • Work from anywhere, anytime, fully remote & async
  • Earn the same salary no matter where you live
  • No standups, no micromanagement, no unnecessary calls
  • Real flexibility, take time for life stuff, no approval needed
  • Work in your own flow; pajamas welcome
  • 30 paid OOO days per year (wherever you are in the world)
  • Yearly team retreats in beautiful locations
  • People-first culture, stable, family-friendly, kind

What Our Team Says

At this company, I'm actually treated like a real person with ideas and a life, not just another number in the system. It's refreshing to work somewhere that gets that happy humans do better work ~ Sean Brydon ( Software Developer)

Working at Cal has been a completely different experience from other jobs I’ve had. There’s real trust here - I’ve been able to take ownership of my work without being micromanaged. I started in support and quickly moved into a growth role because initiative is genuinely rewarded. Everyone communicates openly, and feedback is always encouraged. The async, remote culture has been a game-changer for me. I can structure my day around life: run errands and take breaks without the pressure of always being online. It’s all about getting the work done. As a dad of two, that flexibility means everything. If I need to step away for my family, I can. That kind of trust and support motivates me to do my best work every day. ~ Milos Puac (Enterprise Triage Manager)

description:
The Regional Marketing Director, LATAM is the senior marketing leader for the region, responsible for developing and owning the comprehensive marketing strategy to drive significant revenue growth. This role will lead a team and collaborate with executive leadership across LATAM sales, global marketing, and partner channels to build a scalable, predictable pipeline engine. As a key member of the marketing leadership team, this individual is fully accountable for the region's marketing performance, budget, and business impact, including new logo acquisition and customer expansion.

This role is a versatile and resourceful strategic thinker capable of laying the foundation and seeing projects through to completion. You bring a strong focus on account-based marketing (ABM) programs, with the ability to develop and execute strategies to support account-based selling, and ensure that existing accounts are positioned for further growth. Considering the regional focus, business-level fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish is preferred.

What You'll Do

  • Own strategic vision, planning, execution, and follow-up of LATAM regional marketing plans that create new opportunities, build executive relationships, and impact revenue growth.
  • Drive expansion into the rapidly growing LATAM market, with full ownership of building and executing the regional marketing strategy from the ground up.
  • Provide direct leadership, coaching, and career development for a team of regional marketing managers, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability and professional growth.
  • Deliver cohesive regional marketing programs that include events (online and offline), paid media, social media, partner co-marketing, and more by customizing and deploying the LATAM go-to-market (GTM) strategy that drives regional expansion.
  • Own and manage the complete LATAM marketing budget, including quarterly forecasting, strategic allocation, and ROI analysis to ensure maximum business impact.
  • Act as the primary marketing business partner to LATAM sales leadership, reporting on performance, providing data-driven insights, and collaborating to develop strategies to achieve pipeline and revenue goals.
  • Identify opportunities to incorporate global brand and demand programs and drive scalability in regional demand generation efforts.
  • Travel to select regions to provide onsite support for events as needed.

What You’ll Need

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant career experience.
  • 10+ years of progressive marketing experience with a focus on regional marketing and field/demand generation.
  • Field/demand generation marketing experience in the LATAM region.
  • Experience in the B2B technology and/or SaaS industry.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years in a leadership role with direct people management responsibilities.
  • Business-level fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish is preferred.
  • Proven track record of supporting sales teams to meet or exceed pipeline and revenue targets, with the ability to pivot strategies as needed.
  • Skilled in managing Account-Based Marketing (ABM) programs and implementing demand generation and integrated marketing strategies.
  • Experience working with globally distributed teams, adapting global assets for local needs, and collaborating with geographically dispersed vendors.
  • Proficient in marketing automation, web analytics, business intelligence tools, and budget management.
  • Experience in partner marketing, particularly with large global advisory and consulting firms.
  • Strong communicator with the ability to convey complex ideas and data to diverse audiences in written, spoken, and presentation formats.
  • Highly motivated, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and adaptable to changing market and organizational needs.
  • Familiarity with end-to-end event operations and experience working with top-level executives and speakers is preferred.

Working Conditions & Travel Requirements

Celestica is dedicated to delivering end-to-end product lifecycle solutions to drive our customers' success. If you are a highly motivated individual who can align unique insights to key customer priorities and can engage customers by deliberately linking their business priorities to our value propositions, then we want you on our team.

As the Sales Director, you will be responsible for targeting new customer engagements across various submarkets in the Aerospace and Defense (A&D) space.

The incumbent is accountable to:
  • Develop strong and long-lasting insight-based relationships with our customers and identify mobilizers. The incumbent will act as the primary sales interface for several accounts on a regional basis. More specifically:

  • Identify, develop new accounts in North American region
  • Gains competitive intelligence and always ties insights back to our unique strengths in the market
  • Creates opportunities to provide a unique and contrarian perspective during commercial conversations and is able to reframe the way customers view their business
  • Have deep knowledge of customer's business current macro and microeconomic trends, industry trends and potential new business opportunities
  • Engages the customer by deliberately tying their business priorities to our value proposition
  • Manages the overall customer relationship process while supporting business development in the planning and execution of the account strategies, tactics and selling propositions.
  • Acts as the Customer advocate to ensure that the organization remains customer-focused.
  • Acts as the main focal point to understand customers needs and requests, manages them and delivers business proposals and RFQ responses to customers.
  • Maintains a minimum revenue accountability (a personal sales quota)
  • Establishes value before ROI/financial terms. Is able to qualify and quantify the impact of maintaining the status quo or pursuing competitor's solutions.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies

  • Strong communication, interpersonal, relationship management and professional sales skills
  • Have the ability to work on, and close, multiple prospects simultaneously
  • Experience in high complex service selling within the Aerospace and Defense market segment
  • Understanding of technical and process fundamentals related to electronics and electromechanical products used in the A&D industry and associated compliance standards (AS9100, ITAR, DFAR, FAA)
  • Understanding of the A&D Product Development Process from Concept to Qualification
  • Proven track record of developing business with new clients / developing new markets led by a technical background (either in manufacturing or engineering)

  • Exceptional ability to work with others as part of a cross-functional team.
  • Experience working with vast remote cross-functional teams in large matrix organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to have successfully carried a sales, revenue or operational quota gains.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in business development and client relations specifically related to A&D products (strong network into the A&D industry is required)

Physical Demands

  • Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
  • Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data.
  • Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.
  • Overnight travel may be required.

Typical Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in business development and client relations specifically related to Aerospace & Defense. Preferred experience: 3 years experience selling in the EMS industry.
  • A strong network into the A&D industry is required

Typical Education

  • Bachelor's degree in related field, or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience.

The salary range described in this posting is an estimate by the Company, and may change based on several factors, including by not limited to a change in the duties covered by the job posting, or the credentials, experience or geographic jurisdiction of the successful candidate.

This policy applies to hiring, promotion, discharge, pay, fringe benefits, job training, classification, referral and other aspects of employment and also states that retaliation against a person who files a charge of discrimination, participates in a discrimination proceeding, or otherwise opposes an unlawful employment practice will not be tolerated. Celestica (NYSE, TSX: CLS) enables the world's best brands. OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO CARDIOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital! A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos Especialistas em Cardiologia.

SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH

Nosso time de profissionais desempenha papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, atendendo às demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você.

O QUE PROCURAMOS

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por meio da plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade cardiologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.

PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em cardiologia de forma remota, por meio de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina, conduzir anamnese virtual, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, prescrever medicamentos adequados, monitorar o progresso dos pacientes, ajustar planos conforme resposta do tratamento.
  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde, documentar interações, participar de equipe multiprofissional, manter conhecimento atualizado, respeitar Código de Ética Médica.

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS

  • Graduação em Medicina.
  • Residência médica ou especialização em Cardiologia.
  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM).
  • Certificado de Registro do Título de Especialista em Cardiologia (RQE).
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela ICP‑Brasil.
  • Experiência em atendimento médico em cardiologia; desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.
  • Conhecimento em computação: Pacote Office, Internet; familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina.

LOCAL DE TRABALHO

REMOTO

CONTRATAÇÃO

Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica; necessário representante legal ou sócio de CNPJ ativo.

REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS

A negociar durante processo seletivo.

Esta descrição de cargo / atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico / Generalista Residente em Cardiologia.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel

Software Engineering Manager – Ubuntu Linux Kernel at Canonical. Join to apply for this role.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Software Engineering Managers to lead technical teams in the various aspects of the delivery and ongoing support and maintenance of all Linux kernels provided by the Ubuntu Linux distribution. As the Linux kernel itself is now quite broad, so are the technical domains and challenges involved, ranging from integrating support for bleeding-edge hardware into the latest Ubuntu kernels, to expanding the range of execution environments available to Ubuntu, to the complexities inherent in applying the latest fixes and updates to all of the >100 Ubuntu Linux kernels under active support during our Stable Release Update cycles.

This role would suit either an experienced manager of high performing software development teams, or a very proficient technical lead who is excited to take on a management responsibility. You will need to be passionate about Linux and aspire to be an integral part in its distribution to millions of users worldwide.

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, your primary responsibility is to your team: helping them grow as engineers, do important and satisfying work, and have a great time while doing it. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

Location: Working from home, worldwide. We have kernel teams and openings in every time zone and with the notable exception of Taipei, Taiwan, have no offices and therefore no pressure to work from an office.

Responsibilities

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners

Qualifications

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Overview

Your work days are brighter here. At Workday, our culture centers on putting our people first. We look after our people, communities and the planet while remaining profitable. Feel encouraged to shine and bring your brightest version of you to help us grow.

Workday values candidate privacy and data security. We will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through non-Workday sites or to pay recruiting fees or consulting services to apply.

About the Team

Workday's Managing Partner practice focuses on stewarding subscribers of our Workday Success Plan offering in North America. We serve customers with relevant industry stories, practical value realization from Workday’s technology, and peer learning networks. We act like a start-up inside a larger organization, continuously seeking new ways to help customers succeed on their cloud journey.

About the Role

Workday's Managing Partner practice focuses on stewarding subscribers of our Workday Success Plan offering in North America. We seek to deliver industry stories, practical value realization, and peer learning networks to help customers succeed on their cloud journey.

About You

  • Collaborate with Account Executives and Service Executives to position and sell or upsell Workday product, deployment, and postproduction services into your customer base and ensure maximum value from the product.
  • Own successful deployment of the Workday solution, drive adoption, guide customers in implementing new features, and sell additional services to support their strategy.
  • Participate in sales cycles to support implementation activities for prospects that will join the portfolio.
  • Drive customer self-sufficiency by ensuring customers understand how to engage with the Workday services organization.
  • Partner with colleagues to position additional value through in-subscription adoption, additional subscription products, or activation of offerings from our platform ecosystem.
  • Participate in partner selection for non-Workday-primed engagements.
  • Guide large, partner-led accounts with global complexity (e.g., M&A and divestitures).
  • Create strategic plans across the customer architecture, attend steering committee meetings, and nurture executive relationships.
  • Provide direction and support to Workday and service partner project teams on scope, budget, timeline, and deployment issues; act as the point of contact to facilitate and resolve escalated issues.
  • Engage other service resources to support account planning and feature adoption strategies.
  • Leverage customer relationships for prospect references as needed.

Basic Qualifications:

10+ years’ experience deploying large, sophisticated Cloud SaaS ERP (HCM & Fins) solutions at a project and program manager level within the Diversified Industries arena.

2+ years direct experience with a cloud-native HR or Finance software (such as Workday, SuccessFactors, NetSuite, or similar) as an implementation leader, business function owner, hands-on configuration resource, or workmate.

8+ years of developing and maintaining C-level relationships resulting in successful partnerships and strategic alignment.

Other Qualifications:

  • Experience within the Diversified Industries customer base. Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to engage with key stakeholders to build strong relationships and achieve objectives.
  • Ability to empower and lead a matrixed team at multiple levels within an organization.
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple customer demands balancing satisfaction with revenue and profitability targets.
  • A dedication to continuous improvement in how we serve customers.
  • Proven ability to develop and implement effective account strategies focused on relationships, growth opportunities, and retention.
  • Strong customer insights skills to analyze data, identify trends, and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Exceptional relationship management skills to foster collaboration and trust with clients, partners, and colleagues.
  • Strong account planning skills to analyze customer needs and drive retention and revenue growth.
  • Demonstrated credibility through honesty, expertise, and clear communication.
  • Strong customer engagement and communication skills to increase satisfaction and sales growth.
  • Ability to identify and understand customer needs through market research and problem-solving to inform product development and service improvements.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%.

Workday Pay Transparency Statement

The annual base salary ranges for the primary location and other locations are listed below. Pay ranges vary by location. The total package may include a bonus plan or commissions, and stock grants. Compensation offers consider geography, experience, skills, duties, and business need. For more information regarding benefits, please click here.

Primary Location: USA.WA.Seattle; Primary Location Base Pay Range: $164,500 USD - $246,700 USD; Additional US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $148,900 USD - $264,400 USD.

Our Approach to Flexible Work

With Flex Work, we blend in-person time and remote work to deepen connections and maintain a strong community. Flexibility means you can create a schedule that works for your business, team, and personal needs, with at least 50% in the office or field each quarter when working with customers, prospects, and partners. Remote employees may join offices for important moments.

Pursuant to applicable Fair Chance laws, Workday considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.

Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your Workday connection about our Employee Referral process!

title: Head of Growth Marketing
description:
Overview

Head of Growth Marketing at Common Thread Collective (CTC). This role focuses on crafting data-driven forecasts and executing growth strategies, fostering strong client relationships, and representing CTC’s distinctive approach to media acquisition and its tools.

What We Look For

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if you value core company principles and are ready to commit to high standards in growth marketing and client collaboration.

Responsibilities

  • Lead data-driven growth strategies and forecasting, aligning with client goals and CTC methodologies.
  • Foster transparent communication with clients, detailing steps taken and comparing results to projections.
  • Represent CTC’s approach to media acquisition and associated tools; drive execution and accountability within the team.
  • Contribute to growth initiatives and ensure campaigns are built using CTC’s structure and best practices.
  • Monitor campaigns, adjust budgets and strategies to maximize KPIs and daily projected targets.
  • Develop growth forecasts and maps using the Prophet system; analyze data to support strategic planning.
  • Collaborate with team members (Google Strategist, Creative Strategist, Email Strategist) and ensure data integrity across client work.
  • Lead and participate in ongoing process improvement, ensuring high-quality client deliverables and adherence to timelines.
  • Participate in client communications, providing daily performance updates and weekly strategic updates.

Qualifications & Personal Attributes

  • Autodidact : Naturally curious, quick learner, able to absorb information and apply feedback proactively.
  • Unimpeachable Character : Honest, self-aware, owns outcomes, values constructive feedback.
  • Competitive Greatness : Thrives on hard challenges, persistent, adaptable, and passionate about work.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong data analysis ability; familiarity with Google Sheets; comfortable using data to drive decisions.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills; ability to craft compelling client messaging with emotional intelligence.
  • Experience in growth marketing, media buying, or related fields; capacity to build and adapt growth plans based on data and client needs.

What Success Looks Like

  • Achieve high accuracy within a 5% delta of the forecast in Growth Map and client outcomes.
  • Maintain high client satisfaction and deliver on forecast commitments with rigorous quality standards.
  • Lead the team to optimize productivity and ensure timely delivery of results.
  • Contribute ideas to team discussions and company content; support growth and innovation.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary progression: First month $2,000; Second month $4,000; Third month average $7,000; 1st year $64,000–$76,000; 2nd year $100,000–$120,000 (depending on client load and performance).
  • Performance-based growth, pay transparency, and regular feedback to support career development.

Location & Work Environment

Fully remote with flexible scheduling; autonomy with regular feedback, accountability, and opportunities for growth.

Other

Job is client-facing and involves collaboration within a growth-focused team.

SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH

Nosso time de profissionais desempenha papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, atendendo às demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você.

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por meio da plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade cardiologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.

Head of Product Design (UI / UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor

Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision : bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI / UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to :

Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.

Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.

Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.

Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast : prototype, test, iterate, and refine.

Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.

Build and maintain UI / UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.

Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.

Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.

Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

Battle-tested designer : You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).

AI-forward mindset : You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.

Builder’s DNA : Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.

Technical & design skills :

  • UI / UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus : Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)

Startup mentality : Hands‑on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.

Industry experience : Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open‑source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

Early‑stage, high‑growth startup with real traction.

Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.

Opportunity to shape AI‑native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.

Competitive salary + equity

Diversidade e Inclusão

No Atlântico, a diversidade e a inclusão são compromissos inegociáveis. Como instituto dedicado à pesquisa, desenvolvimento e inovação, valorizamos e incentivamos a pluralidade de pensamentos e vivências, pois isso faz parte do nosso DNA. title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI / UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor

Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision : bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI / UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to :

Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.

Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.

Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.

Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast : prototype, test, iterate, and refine.

Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.

Build and maintain UI / UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.

Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.

Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.

Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

Battle-tested designer : You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).

AI-forward mindset : You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.

Builder’s DNA : Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.

Technical & design skills :

  • UI / UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus : Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)

Startup mentality : Hands‑on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.

Industry experience : Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open‑source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

Early‑stage, high‑growth startup with real traction.

Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.

Opportunity to shape AI‑native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.

Competitive salary + equity

title: Gerente De Projetos De Ti
description:
Quem somos

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.

O que buscamos

Como Gerente de Projetos, você trabalhará em colaboração com a equipe do Studio Rx e os times de Projetos e Client Services nos EUA. Diariamente, você deverá monitorar as atividades dos projetos em andamento, identificando e mitigando riscos, além de manter uma comunicação fluída entre todas as equipes envolvidas.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento do plano do projeto : desde o entendimento e definição do escopo / briefing, passando pela estimativa de esforço e elaboração de cronogramas;
  • Alocação de equipe de acordo com habilidades necessárias, experiência e disponibilidade em parceria com o líder técnico da área de execução do projeto;
  • Gerenciamento e monitoramento das atividades diárias do projeto, garantindo o recebimento de todas as informações e materiais para execução das atividades, seguindo os protocolos de trabalho do Studio no Brasil e EUA;
  • Identificação, avaliação e mitigação de riscos, consolidando as informações em relatórios para a liderança sênior do projeto;
  • Garantir a comunicação entre os times de execução e demais envolvidos no projeto;
  • Esclarecimento de dúvidas quanto ao direcionamento da execução das atividades, interagindo com equipes responsáveis pelo projeto nos EUA;

title: Bolsista Doutor - Bcs Sistemas - Estimular O Uso Do Smartphone No Dia A Dia No Comércio Varejista |
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo. O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Inovar o varejo por meio da tecnologia é o que impulsiona a BCS SISTEMAS, e você pode ser parte dessa transformação. Estamos em busca de talentos criativos, proativos e estratégicos para integrar um projeto que visa desenvolver soluções móveis inteligentes, promovendo o uso efetivo de smartphones no dia a dia das operações do comércio varejista.

Você terá a oportunidade de atuar desde o mapeamento de processos e pesquisa de campo com lojistas e usuários do ERP, até a prototipação, desenvolvimento, integração e validação de aplicativos com tecnologias como nuvem, banco de dados, inteligência artificial, dashboards e notificações — tudo conectado ao ecossistema do nosso ERP.

Se você gosta de aliar tecnologia à experiência do usuário, tem familiaridade com soluções móveis e deseja causar impacto real em um setor essencial da economia, essa vaga é para você.

Formação Acadêmica

Doutorado completo em Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Análise de Sistemas, Sistemas da Informação, Ciências da Computação, Análise de Dados, Tecnologia ou áreas afins.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto

Estimular o uso do smartphone no dia a dia no comércio varejista.

Principais Atividades

  • Mapeamento de Processos Operacionais no Varejo
  • Pesquisa de Campo com Lojistas e Usuários do ERP
  • Prototipação de Soluções Móveis
  • Desenvolvimento e Integração com o ERP
  • Validação em Campo e Iterações de Produto
  • Planejamento de Escalonamento e Estratégia de Adoção
  • Avaliação de Impacto e Documentação Técnica
  • Transferência de Conhecimento e Capacitação Interna

Conhecimento Necessário

  • Desenvolvimento de Aplicativos Móveis
  • UX / UI Design para Mobilidade

Conhecimento Desejável

  • Pesquisa Aplicada e Validação de Soluções em Campo
  • Gestão da Inovação e Desenvolvimento de Produtos
  • Análise de Dados e Tomada de Decisão

title: Pessoa Analista de E-Commerce/Performance
description:
Sobre a Arcos Scale

Somos uma empresa que respira vendas online. Acreditamos no poder das vendas e no impacto que o e-commerce tem no Brasil. É isso que move nosso time e dá sentido ao que fazemos. Na Arcos Scale, seguimos valores que não ficam só no papel: colaboração, respeito, comprometimento, justiça e criatividade. Vivemos isso todos os dias — e esses princípios guiam nossas relações, nosso trabalho e nossa forma de crescer juntos. Se você se identifica com isso, a Arcos pode ser o seu próximo passo.

Missão do Cargo

Buscamos um(a) Analista de E-commerce / Performance – Gestão de Tráfego Pago para Marketplaces com perfil analítico, estratégico e orientado a resultados. Alguém com olhar atento para métricas e performance, capaz de planejar, executar e otimizar campanhas em múltiplas plataformas, garantindo o melhor retorno sobre investimento e crescimento consistente das operações dos nossos clientes.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Planejar, criar, executar e otimizar campanhas de tráfego pago em marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Shopee, Amazon, Shein, entre outros);
  • Estruturar campanhas do zero, com segmentação estratégica, criativos e copy alinhados à persona;
  • Realizar análises avançadas de métricas (CPC, CPA, ROI, LTV, etc.) e propor melhorias contínuas;
  • Monitorar KPIs, identificar oportunidades e realizar otimizações constantes;
  • Coletar e interpretar dados de campanhas, gerando insights e recomendações estratégicas;
  • Administrar e otimizar orçamentos de mídia para garantir o melhor uso dos recursos;
  • Produzir relatórios de desempenho detalhados e apresentações de resultados;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time criativo para desenvolvimento de artes, vídeos e landing pages;
  • Atuar diretamente na gestão de investimentos de anúncios dos clientes em marketplaces.

Obs: Esta vaga é para atuar nas lojas dos marketplaces de nossos clientes. Por isso, é essencial experiência prévia na área.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada com aquisição de clientes via tráfego pago (venda direta);
  • Vivência com campanhas em marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Shopee, Amazon, etc.);
  • Histórico sólido de performance e resultados em campanhas;
  • Habilidade analítica e domínio de métricas de performance (CPC, CPA, ROI, etc.);
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Capacidade para gerir múltiplas campanhas simultaneamente;
  • Organização, autonomia e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas do Google e marketing digital;
  • Habilidade com planilhas e apresentações;
  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando em áreas correlatas (desejável).

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  1. Análise do currículo
  2. Alinhamento de informações – ao vivo
  3. Teste técnico
  4. Apresentação técnica – ao vivo
  5. Entrevista de fit cultural – ao vivo

Informações Adicionais

Remuneração fixa: R$3.500,00

Bônus de performance: até +20% do fixo mediante atingimento de metas

Programa de Partnership / Stock Options – possibilidade de se tornar sócio(a) da Arcos e participar de lucros anuais

Recesso a partir de 12 meses de contrato

title: Supervisor de Padaria
description:
Job description

Este profissional é responsável pela gestão de pessoas, coordena, treina, desenvolve e avalia a equipe. Realiza a gestão operacional do setor de padaria, sendo responsável pelas metas, resultados, ações de vendas e controles internos.


Main responsibilities

Gestão de Pessoas:

  • Participar de processo seletivo, aplicações de medidas disciplinares entre outras situações envolvendo os colaboradores.
  • Administrar as folgas, horários e atestado dos Colaboradores.
  • Acompanhar e fiscalizar o uso de EPIs.
  • Definir astarefas e prioridades dos colaboradores.
  • Avaliar os colaboradores aplicando feedback.
  • Realizar reuniões com a equipe informando sobre as metas, resultados das vendas comparando com a previsão e passando informações de recursos humanos.

Gestão Operacional:

  • Atender clientes internos e externos.
  • Analisar o abastecimento de mercadorias, determinando as prioridades para colaboradores e promotores.
  • Confrontar as alterações de preços com o cartazeamento, a fim de confirmar se estão corretos.
  • Acompanhar constantemente o recebimento de mercadorias para orientar como fazer aestocagem apropriada, e as prioridades.
  • Acompanhar a produção e manipulação de produtos.
  • Acompanhar e analisar o desempenho das vendas e demais indicadores por meio de sistema e relatórios.
  • Realizar o balanço/inventário do setor.
  • Promover exposições e ações de vendas.
  • Realizar plantão de loja.
  • Realizar visitas em fornecedores para introdução de novos produtos.
  • Acompanhar e solicitar a compra e ou manutenção dos equipamentos da Padaria.

Requirements and skills

Qualificações:

  • Conhecimento em panificação e confeitaria, manipulação e higienização de alimentos e em negociação de vendas e compras,
  • Será um diferencial: experiência em varejo, preferencialmente supermercadista.

Requisitos:

  • Desejável ensino superior completo e ou cursando.
  • Habilidades com pacote office em especial Excel.

Additional information

Já falamos tudo o que esperamos de você, agora é hora de contar um pouco do que oferecemos para todos que fazem parte do nosso time:

Nossos Benefícios: Plano de saúde e odontológico referências em nossas áreas de atuação; Refeição na empresa com desconto de R$50,00 ao mês; Vale Transporte; Desconto nas Compras realizadas com o crachá; Convênio com Farmácias; Empréstimo Consignado entre outros benefícios que exigem maior tempo de casa.

E tem mais: O Enxuto investe constantemente em ações de desenvolvimento, oferece oportunidade para primeiro emprego, para profissionais experientes ou não, e prezamos pela diversidade, para nós o que importa é oQuere r, aVontade de fazer o melhor todos os dias, oprazer em Servir eEncantar os nossos clientes internos e externos.

Prezamos por valorizar nossos talentos, por isso, constantemente divulgamos nossas oportunidades primeiramente para quem já faz parte do time, ou seja, você pode iniciar em uma área e ir aproveitando as oportunidades internas.

Importante: Nossos Valores são vividos no dia-a-dia e é crucial que você se identifique com eles:Honestidade, União, Respeito, Profissionalismo, Evolução e Responsabilidade Socioambiental. É a prática desses valores que garantirá que tenhamos uma história sólida onde todos saiam ganhando.

Supervisor de Prevenção de Perdas I Campinas - SP

Nossa história resume bem o que somos: uma combinação entre nosso potencial e a dedicação de quem acredita que limites existem para serem superados.

Sabemos que para ganhar o jogo precisamos dos melhores talentos e estamos aqui para jogar a longo prazo. Por isso, procuramos pessoas que queiram evoluir continuamente e se desafiar a construir algo relevante para nossos clientes.

Foram a ambição e o trabalho dos nossos associados que nos trouxeram até aqui e que continuarão a nos levar adiante. Por isso, buscamos os melhores profissionais, que sejam obcecados por gerar resultados através do time, liderando uma equipe de alta performance.

Se identificou? Então venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Como Supervisor de Prevenção de Perdas, você fará:

  • Visitas em loja: responsável por realizar auditorias presenciais das rotinas e processos em um grupo específico de lojas, efetuando as correções e ajustes necessários para assegurar o controle e a redução de perdas e quebras nas localidades, conforme metas pré-estabelecidas.
  • Tratativa dos indicadores críticos: responsável por monitorar, através de painel de indicadores e imagens, as informações atreladas a perdas e quebras das lojas, identificando possíveis desvios e agindo proativamente para corrigi-los.
  • Investigação de fraudes e desvios: responsável por apurar fraudes, quebras de procedimentos e desvios de mercadorias nas lojas através do canal de denúncias, visitas em loja e análise do painel de indicadores.
  • Acompanhamento de inventário: Responsável por acompanhar a organização e preparo das lojas para a realização de inventários, diagnosticando os resultados e elaborando um plano de ação junto às lojas para melhorar esses resultados.
  • Acompanhamento dos resultados: responsável por realizar reuniões semanais, quinzenais e/ou mensais para atualizar e apresentar resultados, discutir estratégias, e treinar a equipe de prevenção e os associados das lojas nos procedimentos preventivos.
  • Atuação em sinistros: responsável por identificar e implementar ações para mitigar e reduzir ocorrências de sinistros em determinadas localidades, além de fornecer o suporte necessário à loja após um sinistro, garantindo a execução adequada do procedimento pós-sinistro e prevenindo possíveis reincidências.

Você deve ter os seguintes requisitos:

  • Graduação completa;
  • Domínio do pacote office – Intermediário/avançado;
  • Habilidade analítica e estratégica;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
  • Senso de urgência;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Será um diferencial se você possuir:

  • Conhecimento prévio em Prevenção de Perdas;
  • Vivência com Looker ou Power BI;

  • Vivência com SAP.

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos.

Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. title: Agente Prevenção de Perdas
description:
Overview

Caedu busca profissionais que sejam #SoluçãoParaoCliente , #ConfiemColaboremCompartilhem e que tenham #AlegriaEnergiaeAcolhimento ! Atuamos no varejo de moda há 50 anos e estamos presentes nos estados de São Paulo, Rio Grande do Sul, Goiás, DF e Minas Gerais com 100 lojas .

Temos um ambiente alegre e acolhedor e o melhor de tudo, com possibilidade de desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional! Se você busca desafios em sua área de atuação, não abre mão de ética e respeito , tem senso de dono e acredita que juntos somos mais fortes , vem para Caedu .

Na Caedu nós trabalhamos com um propósito claro: Compartilhar o que temos de melhor para vestir histórias mais felizes. Para isso, respeitamos a diversidade, trabalhamos com senso de dono e queremos proporcionar o melhor para os nossos colaboradores e clientes SEMPRE!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar rondas diárias em todas as dependências da loja, principalmente nas áreas de riscos, como provadores, área de vendas, estoques e caixa.
  • Fiscalizar o setor de estoque quando do recebimento e envio de mercadorias e produtos, incluindo a chegada dos caminhões, recebimento, contagem e conferência de peças e equipamentos pelos operadores, controle dos coletores e notas fiscais, de modo a contribuir para a redução de perdas e riscos para a empresa.
  • Responder pelos registros nos livros de prevenção e perdas, informando data, horário e tipo de ocorrência, com relação a colaboradores e clientes, apresentando a supervisão e gerência para controles diversos e GPP.
  • Atuar de forma discreta na prevenção de roubos e furtos nas dependências internas, entradas e saídas da loja, observando atitudes suspeitas e delitos, utilizando rádio para comunicar, obter orientações e aplicar ações de acordo com as regras e procedimentos, de modo a minimizar os riscos para a empresa, informando à gerência.
  • Acompanhar o gerente e supervisores na abertura e fechamento da loja, fazendo rondas em todo o perímetro da mesma, bem como na chegada e saída do carro forte, contribuindo para a segurança do patrimônio e numerários.
  • Contribuir para a redução dos custos com consumo de água e energia, através de vistorias de hora em hora nos setores tomando ações para eliminar consumos desnecessários.
  • Acompanhar as imagens dos monitores de segurança (CFTV) nas dependências internas da empresa, verificando as ações, monitorando as ocorrências e efetuando as gravações e backups diários com o apoio da equipe de Prevenção de Perdas de modo a registrar todos os movimentos para controles, possíveis investigações e decisões corretivas pela empresa.
  • Realizar o controle e entrega de chaves dos armários e vistorias dos pertences dos colaboradores, anotando as ocorrências em formulários específicos, informando à supervisão os problemas detectados.
  • Realizar o controle de entrada e saída dos produtos nos provadores, observando e efetuando a entrega, conferência e recebimento de fichas junto aos clientes, registrando as intercorrências em formulários específicos, conforme orientações dos manuais.
  • Conferir através do coletor com o apoio dos líderes da loja, os produtos recebidos em loja com procedência de troca, bem como executar a conferência e controle dos produtos danificados, verificando se os itens estão devidamente etiquetados e com os alarmes corretamente posicionados, solicitando ao superior ou responsável ações corretivas, com os devidos registros nos livros.

title: Head Of Product Design (Ui/Ux, Ai-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI / UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor

Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision : bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI / UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to :

Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.

Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.

Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.

Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast : prototype, test, iterate, and refine.

Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.

Build and maintain UI / UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.

Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.

Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.

Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

Battle-tested designer : You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).

AI-forward mindset : You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.

Builder’s DNA : Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.

Technical & design skills :

  • UI / UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus : Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)

Startup mentality : Hands‑on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.

Industry experience : Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open‑source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

Early‑stage, high‑growth startup with real traction.

Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.

Opportunity to shape AI‑native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.

Competitive salary + equity

SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH

Nosso time de profissionais desempenha papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, atendendo às demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você.

O QUE PROCURAMOS

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por meio da plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade cardiologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.

PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES

description:
Engenheiro Dados SeniorTrabalho RemotoEfetivo

Join to apply for the Engenheiro Dados SeniorTrabalho RemotoEfetivo role at KMM

Descrição da vaga

Mais do que simples fornecedores de tecnologia, nos destacamos como verdadeiros especialistas em logística. Nossas soluções são moldadas pela vasta experiência que acumulamos ao longo dos anos, refletindo a sabedoria e os aprendizados adquiridos ao longo de nossa jornada. É essa expertise que nos capacita a oferecer uma abordagem personalizada e altamente eficaz para cada cliente.

Por mais de 25 anos, trabalhamos com operações logísticas de grande escala, servindo a uma variedade de setores, incluindo indústrias, varejistas, operadores logísticos e transportadoras. Mantendo um olhar perspicaz sobre as tendências do mercado, desenvolvemos sistemas adaptáveis que se ajustam às necessidades em constante evolução de nossos clientes.

Nossa trajetória de pioneirismo ao longo dos últimos anos nos proporcionou um amplo know-how e expertise em todas as nuances do setor logístico. Essa jornada nos permitiu acumular valiosa experiência e nos destacar como líderes em oferecer as melhores práticas do mercado.

Além de nosso conhecimento aprofundado, a segurança é uma prioridade essencial para nós. Somos certificados pela ISO/IEC 27001, garantindo que adotemos os mais rigorosos padrões em segurança da informação, demonstrando nosso compromisso com a proteção de nossos parceiros e clientes.

Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados e determinados para se juntarem a nós como Engenheiro de Dados. Se você tem vontade de aprender, transformar a logística e mobilidade e fazer a diferença, essa é a sua oportunidade!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O Engenheiro de Dados Sênior será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines e arquiteturas de dados robustas, escaláveis e seguras. Atuará em estreita colaboração com o time de dados e as áreas de negócio para garantir a disponibilidade e confiabilidade das informações utilizadas em análises e produtos de dados.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Desenvolver, orquestrar e monitorar pipelines de dados utilizando Apache Airflow, aplicando boas práticas de modularização e versionamento de DAGs.
  • Implementar rotinas de monitoramento e alertas (logs estruturados, métricas e notificações via Grafana, email, etc.).
  • Atuar na modelagem e implementação das camadas bronze, silver e gold em um Data Lake baseado em Databricks.
  • Construir e manter integrações de dados a partir de APIs REST, bancos relacionais, arquivos CSV/Excel/Parquet e filas de mensagens.
  • Desenvolver estratégias eficientes de carga incremental, controle de versionamento e catalogação de fontes.
  • Revisar e otimizar consultas SQL complexas em PostgreSQL e Oracle (PL/SQL), garantindo desempenho e uso eficiente de recursos.
  • Trabalhar com object storage (S3), definindo estratégias de versionamento, compactação e organização de arquivos.
  • Garantir a observabilidade e qualidade dos pipelines, com testes unitários e de integração e documentação técnica atualizada.
  • Participar de ritos ágeis e colaborar na modelagem de tabelas analíticas voltadas a ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik).
Experiências Desejadas
  • Vivência em ambientes de dados complexos, com múltiplas fontes e alto volume de informação.
  • Experiência comprovada na construção de pipelines de ETL/ELT em produção.
  • Atuação anterior com arquitetura em camadas (bronze/silver/gold) e governança de dados.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Obrigatórios
  • Domínio de Python para desenvolvimento de pipelines e automações.
  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL (consultas complexas, tuning, índices, CTEs, particionamento, views materializadas).
  • Experiência sólida com Apache Airflow (orquestração, versionamento, monitoramento).
  • Experiência com PostgreSQL e modelagem de dados para Data Lake.
  • Familiaridade com object storage (S3 ou equivalente) e formatos otimizados de arquivo (Parquet, ORC, GZIP).
  • Prática com Git e boas práticas de versionamento de código.
Desejável (diferenciais)
  • Conhecimento em Oracle/PLSQL.
  • Experiência com Databricks ou ambientes similares (Spark, Delta Lake).
  • Noções de Docker, DBT e monitoramento com Prometheus/Grafana.
  • Formação superior em áreas como Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou correlatas.
  • Certificações em cloud ou engenharia de dados (AWS, Azure, Databricks, etc.) serão consideradas um diferencial.
Informações adicionais

No KMM by nstech, temos uma cultura baseada em valores e esperamos que todos os nstechers não apenas se identifiquem, mas também vivam essa cultura em seu dia a dia.

Acreditamos que a cultura é uma das maiores vantagens competitivas para negócios bem-sucedidos, pois é algo que não pode ser copiado integralmente.

Nossos Pilares Culturais e Seus Atributos São
  • Servir: foco no cliente, humildade, transparência e ética;
  • Equipe: valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a vontade de colocar a mão na massa e o espírito colaborativo;
  • Resultados: buscamos agilidade, melhoria contínua, geração de valor a longo prazo e foco nos resultados.

Por que fazer parte da nstech?

Temos a visão de ser a plataforma de tecnologia para logística e mobilidade que conecta os elos e gera mais valor para os negócios da rede integrada de logística da América Latina.

Atualmente, contamos com uma equipe de mais de 5 mil nstechers comprometidos em melhorar o mundo por meio da tecnologia aplicada à logística e mobilidade.

Estamos empenhados em gerar impacto para a sociedade, clientes, colaboradores e acionistas, e queremos somar forças com pessoas cheias de energia e propósito para fazer parte de nossa equipe e dessa transformação.

Esta vaga é REMOTO e CLT, com benefícios integrados: plano de saúde, odontológico, seguro de vida, flex, Gympass, Zenklub, folga no aniversário.

description:
Head of Product Design (UI / UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor

Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision : bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI / UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to :

Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.

Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.

Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.

Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast : prototype, test, iterate, and refine.

Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.

Build and maintain UI / UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.

Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.

Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.

Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

Battle-tested designer : You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).

AI-forward mindset : You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.

Builder’s DNA : Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.

Technical & design skills :

  • UI / UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus : Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)

Startup mentality : Hands‑on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.

Industry experience : Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open‑source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

Early‑stage, high‑growth startup with real traction.

Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.

Opportunity to shape AI‑native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.

Competitive salary + equity

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI / UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor

Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision : bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI / UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to :

Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.

Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.

Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.

Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast : prototype, test, iterate, and refine.

Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.

Build and maintain UI / UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.

Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.

Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.

Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

Battle-tested designer : You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).

AI-forward mindset : You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.

Builder’s DNA : Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.

Technical & design skills :

  • UI / UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus : Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)

Startup mentality : Hands‑on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.

Industry experience : Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open‑source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

Early‑stage, high‑growth startup with real traction.

Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.

Opportunity to shape AI‑native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.

Competitive salary + equity
